description: Log a CLOSED time entry on a card — work already done. Provide seconds or a duration string ("2h 30m"). For an ongoing timer use zuuna_start_timer / zuuna_stop_timer instead.

card.description: Card key (e.g. "ZNA-2001") or card id. Both work everywhere a card is addressed.

duration.description: Duration like "2h 30m". Provide this or seconds.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds. Provide this or duration.

name: zuuna_log_time
title: zuuna_log_time
